environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB has a single HTTPS listener forwarding to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No AWS WAF association. SQLite database stored on instance EBS volume at /var/data/users.db. Application runs as systemd service under 'appuser' account.
